description: Bilan d'émissions de gaz à effet de serre par scope et opérateur is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Le bilan des émissions de gaz à effet de serre (BEGES) est une empreinte carbone qui comprend les émissions directes et indirectes des activités d’une organisation. Les partenaires ont fait le choix de prendre en compte un périmètre large avec, notamment, les émissions indirectes liées au cycle de vie de leur patrimoine industriel et tertiaire. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are GES, RSE. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
